statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-39883 affects go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk@1.40.0 embedded in the etcd binary, which is an upstream artifact included from dhi/etcd. Bumping otel/sdk to v1.43.0 in the etcd image definition is required. Waiting for the etcd image to be rebuilt with the fix.
